verses.gurmukhi: ੨੨ : ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਹਿਂਮਾਂ ਸਿੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
verses.translit_en: 22 : guroo dhee mahi(n)maa(n) si'kh noo(n) upadhesh

en.bdb: Glory of the Guru, teaching for the Sikh  ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਹੁ ਹੰਸ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਧੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੈ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: ha(n)sahu ha(n)s giaan kar dhudhai vichahu kaddai paanee|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs are those swans who on the basis of their knowledge sift water (falsehood) from milk (truth).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਛਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਘੁੰਮਣਵਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: kachhahu kachh dhiaan dhar lahar na viaapai ghu(n)manavaanee|

en.bdb: Among turtles, they are such ones who remain uninfluenced by waves and whirlpools.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੰਜਹੁ ਕੂੰਜੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਉਡੈ ਅਸਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: koo(n)jahu koo(n)j vakhaaneeaai simaran kar uddai asamaanee|

en.bdb: They are like siberian cranes who go on remembering the Lord while flying high.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: guraparachai gur jaaneeaai giaan dhiaan simaran gurbaanee|

en.bdb: Only by loving the Guru, the Sikh knows, understands and learns the knowledge, meditation and Gurbani, the holy hymns.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh lai gursikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat jag a(n)dhar jaanee|

en.bdb: Having adopted the teachings of the Guru, the Sikhs become gursikhs, the Sikhs of the Guru, and join the holy congregation wherever they find it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi garab nivaar gareebee aanee|

en.bdb: The humility could be cultivated only by bowing at the feet, becoming the dust of feet of the Guru and by deleting ego from the self.
Only such persons take feet-wash of the Guru and their speech becomes nectar (for others).
